chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his father, from al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him), that he said:
"Whoever prays and then sits in his place of prayer until the sunrise, there is for him a protection from the Fire."
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of sitting in the place of prayer after Fajr until sunrise?
ai.summary: In the Shia tradition, this practice of *istikhbar* (lingering in supplication) after Fajr is highly emphasized as a time when divine acceptance is most likely, transforming the post-prayer stillness into a shield against the Hellfire. This reflects the scholarly view that the transition from ritual prayer to personal devotion is a critical period for spiritual fortification and divine mercy.
